title: Netlist surges as Micron agrees to pay $600M for five-year license agreement
key_facts: Micron agreed to a $600M settlement with Netlist.
Payments of $30M a quarter, Q4 2026 to Q3 2031.
Micron gets a five-year worldwide licence covering Netlist patents, including server memory modules and HBM.
Both sides to dismiss all pending cases and release claims.
Netlist previously won a $445M jury verdict against Micron in Texas.
Netlist had sought a US International Trade Commission import ban.
Follows an earlier settlement between Netlist and Samsung.
quote_evidence: Micron Technology Inc. has agreed to a $600 million financial settlement with Netlist Inc. to resolve an extensive series of patent infringement disputes.
Micron will disburse payments of $30 million quarterly.
Micron obtains a five-year worldwide license covering Netlist's patented memory technologies.
why_it_matters_hint: Ends patent risk to Micron's server and HBM memory.
